summary: Implements a React landing page for “Aurise” with a dark aura-themed Tailwind styling and an animated background effect that respects reduced-motion. However, the required generated static image assets are not present in the diff summary, and the change set introduces Internet Identity / actor plumbing that was explicitly listed as a non-goal.

missing_requirements.requirement: Generate and include custom static image assets (background + emblem) as static files under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them from the frontend.
missing_requirements.reason: The landing page references the expected paths, but the diff summary shows no added files under frontend/public/assets/generated, so the required images themselves are not included/verified as present.

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity provider/authentication context and identity-aware actor creation (React Query integration).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly lists user authentication flows (Internet Identity) as a non-goal unless requested later; these hooks/providers go beyond the purely-visual landing page requirements.
No backend functionality or data fetching was requested (non-goals include backend models/CRUD/external APIs), but React Query is wired in globally.
No backend work was requested (scope was visuals only), yet a backend entry file was added (even if minimal).
